about: What each dream file says that its pictures need, one fact per line and one thing per fact, for the listening test (evals/listening.ts): whether the simulated dreamer, who knows only the file, ever told it, and whether Berry ever asked about it. Written by hand from dreams/<name>.md (26 Sep), for the 20 dreams with simulated conversations; a fact joining two things ("a tall man in a blue suit") read as not told when only one was, so each is its own line. Kinds: who (someone or something alive in it), where (a place), look (how someone, something or the dream looks), light (the time of day, the light), size (a size, a scale or a height), position (where someone is, or what they hold). Nothing the file does not say.

car-park.fact: The dream looks like an old black and white film.
The picture is grainy and flickering.
The dream is in a big concrete car park.
There is a thin grey dog.
The dog sits on the ramp.
The same number, level 4, is painted on every wall.
The dreamer comes out on the roof of the car park.
The rain falls upwards, from the ground into the sky.
The dreamer's car is a little wooden rowing boat.
The boat is parked in a space between the lines.
The grey dog is already sitting in the boat.

crayon-cat.fact: The dream looks like a crayon drawing a six-year-old did.
The lines are thick and waxy, with colours going over the edges.
The dreamer is tiny, as small as a mouse.
The dream is in the dreamer's mum's back garden.
The grass is taller than the dreamer.
There is their old cat, Biscuit.
Biscuit is enormous, as big as a bus to the dreamer.
Biscuit carries the dreamer by the back of their jumper.
Biscuit climbs up onto the roof of the house.
There is a cat in every garden in the street, dozens of them.
The cats in the gardens all look up at them.

desert-station.fact: The dream looks like a comic book.
It has thick black lines and flat colours.
Every shadow is a hard black shape.
The dream is at a tiny train station in the middle of a desert.
The station has just one bench.
There is a clock on a pole.
The sand goes on forever in every direction.
The old man wears a white suit.
The old man sits on the bench.
A camel stands next to the old man.
The clock is melting, dripping down the pole like wax.
The old man and the camel get smaller as they walk away.

flooded-library.fact: The dream is in the big reading room of the old city library.
There is a green glass lamp on every desk.
The shelves go up to the ceiling.
Water comes in under the doors.
The water rises over the desks.
The floating books are open like birds.
The dreamer's older sister is there.
The sister is in a little yellow rowing boat.
A whale swims past under the water.
The whale is so big it fills the whole aisle.
There is a high round window at the top of the room.
Outside the window it is morning.
Outside, the whole city is underwater.
Only rooftops and the tops of trees show above the water.

glass-window.fact: The dreamer is at their parents' house.
On the other side of the window is a world made of glass.
The view is translucent but blurry.
The trees, grass and rocks there are made of glass.

grandma-kitchen.fact: The dream is in black and white.
It looks like an old film with scratches on it.
The dream is in the dreamer's grandmother's kitchen from when they were little.
The kitchen has a checked floor.
The kitchen has a big round clock.
The grandmother is at the table cutting a cake.
The dreamer's uncle Ray is there.
Uncle Ray leans in the doorway.
There is a phone on the wall.
The phone has a long curly cord.
The kitchen gets smaller around them, the walls moving in.
The dreamer becomes a child again.
The dreamer wears a red cardigan.

hotel-orchard.fact: The dream is in an old hotel.
The dreamer is in a tiny lift.
The lift has a folding metal gate.
The dreamer's best friend from school, Tomas, is with them.
The dreamer and Tomas are adults at first.
Tomas becomes about ten years old.
Tomas wears their old school uniform.
The lift opens onto an orchard with rows of apple trees.
Every apple glows softly like a lamp.
The horse stands in the middle of the orchard.

icehead.fact: The dreamer is talking to a young woman.
They are standing by the autoclave.
The woman walks off to the far end of the room and comes back.
The woman has a block of glittering ice on her shoulders in place of her head.
The woman stands in front of the dreamer, not saying anything.
The ice melts into the head of a horse.
The horse's head is clear ice, with eyes, ears and nostrils.

jellyfish-city.fact: The dream looks like an anime.
It has sharp lines and really saturated colours.
The sky is an orange sunset.
The dreamer is on the roof of their apartment block.
The apartment block is in a big city.
There is a girl the dreamer doesn't know.
The girl has short blue hair.
The girl wears a yellow raincoat.
The girl has an old red bicycle.
A giant jellyfish floats over the city.
The jellyfish is as big as a stadium.
The jellyfish's long tentacles hang down between the buildings.
The dreamer sits on the back of the girl's bicycle.
The city's lights are coming on below them.

lighthouse.fact: The dreamer walks along a grey beach.
The dreamer's dog is with them.
The dog is a small brown terrier.
The dreamer carries an old brass key in their hand.
There is a white lighthouse at the end of the beach.
Inside is a spiral staircase that goes round and round.
At the top is a round room with windows all the way round.
The father sits at a table.
The father folds paper boats out of newspaper.
The sea turns into a field of tall yellow grass.
A red tractor drives slowly through the grass.
A driver the dreamer doesn't know drives the tractor.
The dreamer is in the tractor's cab, next to the driver.

meads-house.fact: The dream is at the Meads's house.
The house is bigger inside than out.
Just inside there is a European village.
The village has a cobblestone street.
There is a Pied-Piper sort of man.
The Pied-Piper man has curly hair.
There are back stairs, with a second set going straight down the other side.
There is a short empty hallway that turns a corner.
The room at the end of the hallway is tiny.
A young woman is in the tiny room, cooking.
The young woman has blonde hair.
Her hair is shoulder-length, in a pageboy.
The stove almost fills the room.
The dreamer's aunt picks them up.
The aunt drives a little round convertible.
They cross a little bridge over a creek.
The dreamer sits with a couple of people.
They play with a string of blue balloons.

moon-market.fact: The dream is super bright and colourful, like neon signs at night.
Pinks, blues and greens glow against the grey.
The dream is at a night market on the moon.
The ground is grey and dusty.
The Earth hangs big and blue in the sky.
Lots of people are there in ordinary clothes, no spacesuits.
A robot sells noodles at one stall.
The robot is tall and thin.
The robot has a round head.
The noodles are in glowing bowls.
The dreamer's best friend Priya is with them.
Paper lanterns float up from the stalls into the sky.
The dreamer and Priya jump until they are above the stalls.

night-bus.fact: The dreamer is on a night bus.
The dreamer's younger brother is with them.
An old woman sits knitting at the back of the bus.
The brother holds a paper lantern with a candle inside.
The street lights outside melt into long orange ribbons.
Then the dreamer is in their grandmother's kitchen.
In the kitchen it is morning.
The grandmother is at the stove making tea.
The grandmother's hair is completely white.
The lantern is now glowing blue.
About eight or ten neighbours are there, watching quietly.
The neighbours are squeezed into the doorway.
The kitchen table turns into a small wooden boat.
The street where the bus was is a river now.
The brother waves from the bank.

night-market.fact: The dream is at a night market.
The dreamer's older sister is with them.
The market is crowded with hundreds of people.
Strings of little yellow lights hang over the stalls.
An old man sells fish at a stall.
The fish are laid out on ice.
The fish is about as long as the dreamer's arm.
The old man wraps the fish in newspaper.
The dreamer holds the fish against their chest.
The sister and the dreamer ride one bicycle together.
The sister pedals and the dreamer sits on the back.
They ride over a narrow iron bridge.
The bridge is above a black river.
The lights of the market are behind them.

office-snow.fact: The dream looks like a watercolour painting.
The colours run into each other.
The dreamer is at their desk in the office where they work.
It is a normal grey afternoon.
The snowflakes are big and slow.
The snow comes down from the ceiling lights.
The other people in the office keep typing.
The snow covers the desks and keyboards.
Only the tops of the computer screens show above the snow.
The dreamer's manager, Dele, comes over.
The snowman still holds Dele's coffee mug.
The snowball glows a little in the dreamer's hand.

paper-city.fact: Everything looks flat, like it was cut out of coloured paper.
The colours are bright reds, yellows and blues.
There is no shading at all.
The dreamer walks through a city made of paper.
Paper houses lean over a narrow street.
There are people everywhere, flat like cardboard cutouts.
The people all go the same way.
The dreamer's mum is at a corner.
The mum gives the dreamer a little red paper bird.
The rain is hundreds of tiny paper birds of all colours.
The houses fold down flat one after another, like a pop-up book closing.
The dreamer and their mum end up standing on a big sheet of white paper.

school-bird.fact: The dreamer is back at their old school.
The dreamer walks down a very long green corridor.
There are lockers on both sides of the corridor.
There is a wooden door at the end of the corridor.
The door has a small round window.
The classroom is full of students at rows of desks.
None of the students have faces, just smooth skin.
Their old maths teacher, Mrs Okafor, is there.
Mrs Okafor wears a red cardigan.
Mrs Okafor is writing numbers on the blackboard.
Mrs Okafor becomes a tall grey heron.
The heron still wears the red cardigan.
The dreamer flies next to her over the town.
The school roof is far below them.
The dreamer feels very small, like a sparrow.

sea-school.fact: Everything is murky blue and green.
It looks like a fish tank that needs cleaning.
Light comes down in wobbly beams from above.
The dreamer is back at their primary school.
The dreamer swims down the corridor.
The desks in the old classroom are covered in seaweed.
The other pupils are little silver fish sitting at the desks.
Their teacher, Mr Hale, is at the front.
Mr Hale wears a brown jacket.
Mr Hale turns into a huge orange octopus.
The octopus still holds the chalk in one arm.
The school bell comes out as a big stream of bubbles.
All the fish swim out of the window at once.

snow-train.fact: The dreamer is on an old train going through snow.
The dreamer's grandfather, who died years ago, is there.
The dreamer sits across from their grandfather.
The grandfather has a brown leather suitcase.
The suitcase is on the grandfather's knees.
Outside the window everything is white and blue.
The suitcase is full of letters.
The letters are all addressed to the dreamer.
The train stops in the middle of a snowy field.
There is a red door standing on its own.
There is no house around the door.
The grandfather gives the dreamer the suitcase.
On the other side of the door is warm yellow light.

streetcar.fact: The dreamer is riding on a streetcar.
The conductor turns a lever when they round a bend.
The streetcar turns into a train.
The dreamer is on top of the train.
The train is travelling very fast.
Another family is sitting on top of the train too.
A small baby is there, thrilled with the ride.
The train is on a country road.
